_doc: Maps each practice-task outcome onto one of the target's four outcome families (ssb.predict.FAMILY: trust / policy / belief / behaviour), or to null where the target has no analogue. WRITTEN AND FROZEN BEFORE ANY FAMILY SLOPE WAS FITTED (run 20260815-practice-01); the justification for every mapped outcome is the adapter's own `question` text, written before the first paid call. An outcome with no honest target analogue is mapped to null and contributes to no family slope - forcing it into the nearest family would be inventing evidence for a number stage 6 multiplies by.

Belief_Post: belief that human activity causes climate change <-> belief_post
Intent_Post: political climate action intentions; the target's behaviour family is intention-and-act
IntentNp_Post: adapter: '3 verbatim target behavior_* items' <-> behavior_mean
Donation: allocation to climate orgs <-> donation_ams (different unit, same construct)
Candidate_Post: climate-candidate support: between policy and behaviour, and the target has no candidate item. Not forced.
Companies_Post: attitudes to companies: no target analogue

concern_risk: 'concerned about climate change / poses risks to me' <-> concern_mean
action_intention: 'do you intend to do this action more or less' <-> behavior_mean
petition_sign: REAL act, 0/1 per petition <-> newsletter_signup's costly-act shape
msg_rel_self: perceived message relevance: no target analogue
msg_rel_social: perceived message relevance: no target analogue
action_env_impact: perceived efficacy of actions: closest to a belief, but the target's belief items are about climate change itself, not about action efficacy. Not forced.

newsletter1: adapter: 'closest analogue of the target's newsletter_signup'
donation: adapter: 'same units as the target's donation_ams'

SHAREcc: REAL act: shared on social media
WEPTcc: REAL act: effortful task screens completed

trust_overall: every outcome of this task is trust in scientists on the same two 7-point bipolar items (credible / trustworthy); the map is forced by the instrument, not chosen
credibility: every outcome of this task is trust in scientists on the same two 7-point bipolar items (credible / trustworthy); the map is forced by the instrument, not chosen

voelkel2024_note: Every voelkel2024 outcome maps to null. It is a DEMOCRACY megastudy - partisan animosity, support for undemocratic practices, partisan violence. None of it shares a construct with any target family. It informs the pooled slope's reference class question (finding 29: it is the fold that breaks the map) and no family slope.
_gligoric_note: gligoric2025 was added in session 12, AFTER the family map was frozen. The addition carries no discretion: all eight of its outcomes are the same trust-in-scientists battery, so there is no alternative mapping to choose between, and the task is `exclude_from_slope` in its adapter for two independent reasons (conservatives-only subgroup; negative signal variance), so it cannot enter any fitted slope, pooled or per-family.
